title: S OS Studio Navigation and Create
description: Fix wgpu studio navigation (navigate op, double-click demo studio) and add footer Create tool group with Temporary/File/Folder persistence kinds.
summary:
Implemented wgpu S OS studio navigation and Create persistence kinds.

- wgpu `apply_ops` now handles `navigate`, `requestFileSave`, and `requestFolderPick` ops; added `apply_shell_uri` / `switch_to_s_app` so double-click and create-studio navigation switch Home ↔ Studio sessions.
- Back/forward/up navigation re-applies the shell URI.
- `refresh_ui` falls back to static `AppDefinition.modes[].tools` so footer tools render (Create collection visible on Home).
- S Home footer: Create tool group with Temporary / File / Folder (Folder native-only via cfg).
- Persistence: Temporary uses `MemoryBackbonePort`; File uses dev backbone + native save dialog (`bindStudioFile` + `NativeFileBackbonePort`) or wasm download; Folder creates `.semio/studio.db` via `SqliteFolderBackbonePort` (native, rusqlite).
- Exported `OsStudioCatalogEntry` from framework-os for catalog helpers.
- Added unit tests and verify-log.md.
